<!-- cli-reference:start — generated by `go run ./tools/sitecli` from the CLI; edit the command's help in the code, not this block -->

Impact analysis: what a change to this file reaches.

```text
Queries the map and shows, for a changed file, TWO dimensions:

  • Propagates to — the children that depend on it and need to be redone (the wave,
    going down; stops at @noPropagation nodes).
  • Validates against — the parents it must be confronted with (going up;
    a divergence here becomes an issue, not propagation).

Query only — it opens no issue and changes nothing.
```

## Usage

```bash
anchors impact <file> [flags]
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--map` |  | path to the map (default: <root>/anchors.graph.yaml) |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |
